attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Throw|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Hammer Throw
steps: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

attacks.name: God of Thunder
steps: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

superPowers.name: Prince of Asgard (Affiliation: Asgard)
superPowers.body: At the start of each of your Turns, 1 allied character may spend 1 |!power|. If it does, remove 1 |!damage| or 1 special condition from that character. Each allied character may use this |!leadership| only once per Round.

superPowers.name: For Asgard!
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by a |*Strike| attack. After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Strongest Avenger
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of |!size| 4 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Asgardian
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

erratas.body: "For Asgard!"'s Strike attack is not an attack action anymore but a simple attack.
Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side.
Power cost for "God of Thunder" decreased from 6 to 4. All target characters will gain the |§shock§Shock| special condition.
Immunities to Shock and Stun added.
